title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Meadowbrook Physical Therapy under your health plan for services provided on June 10, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.
Reason for denial: The upper GI endoscopy with biopsy is not a covered benefit under your plan. It is listed as an exclusion in your benefit booklet. Reason code: CO-96.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $2,525.33 billed. The amount you may owe the provider is $2,525.33.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: Your written appeal must be received by December 30, 2026. Send it to Calloway Health Network, Appeals Unit, PO Box 19395, Orlando, FL 32801. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-3701.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
